description: Run QA across incoming recognition and outgoing controlled publication. First prove that a live incoming like becomes one local social-signal event without a reply. Then run a manual proactive review, inspect one simulated like, approve one live like, and verify it through protocol readback and the public DelveTown page after a fresh load. Restart or reopen durable state before the final receipt check. Confirm the actor, target URI and CID, effect key, budget update, no duplicate job, no duplicate like, and no unintended post or reply. Record the public target URL and evidence in this issue. If any check fails, report failure and create or link a corrective issue.

comments.text: QA failed on 2026-10-06. Manual proactive job 42 completed once but chose skip with model_reason=direct_request_pending. SQLite contains seven reply events left pending from the page last completed at 2026-10-06T02:15:00Z. Manual reactive job 43 then failed on attempt 1 with cycle_failed invalid_participation_image_proposal while selecting a welcome. Protocol writes remained disabled; no like, reply, post, or follow was published. Corrective issues: created jido_del-322.8: Do not fail participation when an optional image proposal is invalid and created jido_del-322.9: Drain observed notification events before advancing the scan cursor. Both block this QA issue.

title: Verify the controlled like workflow end to end
